snippet.title: Warframe | The Vallis Undermind Official Gameplay Trailer - Available Now On All Platforms!
snippet.description:
Descend deep below Fortuna in the latest major Warframe update: The Vallis Undermind! Aid Nightcap and command a fungal network with the mushroom Warframe, Nokko. Protect the Sprodlings from the greedy clutches of the Corpus and be greatly rewarded...

Add new Customizations to your Arsenal with the Wukong Qitian and Lavos Khymia Collections.

Start playing The Vallis Undermind today!

►► WHAT IS WARFRAME? 

Join 85M+ registered players in Warframe, a cooperative, free-to-play third-person looter shooter set in a constantly evolving sci-fi universe. For more info, visit https://warframe.com.
